engine.notes: Indianapolis improv runs through ComedySportz's Wit Theater on the south side. Red Curb is between homes after leaving Avon, and IF Theatre (formerly IndyFringe) on St Clair Street is the downtown stage most troupes use.

entries.name: ComedySportz Indianapolis (The Wit Theater)
entries.summary: Indianapolis's ComedySportz franchise since 1993, moved from Mass Ave to The Wit Theater on Shelby Street in 2023, with matches every Friday and Saturday, stand-up and open-mic nights, and a School of Improv in two tracks.
entries.schedule: Matches Fridays 7:30pm and Saturdays; seven-week class sessions start January, March, May, July and September
signals: Five seven-week class sessions a year
Short-form and long-form tracks from Improv 101
Drop-in workshops and a high-school league
Moved to The Wit Theater in 2023
entries.reasons: Thirty-three years, a theater of its own, weekly matches and a school with a dated term calendar in two tracks; only the cross-town move and modest scale keep it under ninety.

entries.name: Defiance Comedy
entries.summary: An Indianapolis improv company performing at IF Theatre's Basile stage downtown, with a six-week Intro to Improv course and an advanced character class that ends in a showcase.
entries.schedule: Scary-Oke fundraiser October 30, 7pm; six-week intro courses
entries.reasons: A working company with classes and a regular downtown stage, but no venue of its own and few dated shows on the site.

entries.name: Red Curb Comedy
entries.summary: A comedy company that ran its own theater in Avon and now brings improv to partner venues such as IF Theatre and The Wit while planning a Mass Avenue home, with classes offered jointly with the forthcoming Crossroads Comedy Theater.
entries.schedule: Shows announced one at a time; last listed September 19, 2026 at IF Theatre
signals: Performs at IF Theatre and The Wit
Announced a move to Mass Ave in December 2024
September 26 show at The Wit cancelled
entries.reasons: Between homes, with a one-show calendar, an empty classes page and a future theater whose site is still under construction.
